d:
Kuvitsomasyapamiti | Have I been drinking soma?
Rigveda 10.119 is one of the strangest and most joyful hymns in the Rigveda. The speaker drinks soma and the hymn follows the rush, one verse at a time. First he wants a cow and a horse. Then the drinks lift him like winds shaking the trees. The five tribes of people look like a speck in his eye. Heaven and earth together are not worth one of his wings. He offers to pick up the earth and put it down here, or maybe there. Then he walks home, all dressed up.
